verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official Stripe CLI for building, testing, and managing a Stripe integration from the command line, and a probe confirmed its documentation page exists. Evidence of its depth for Billing workflows or AI-native use is thin. Missing for 10: Billing-specific CLI commands (subscriptions, invoices, meters) evidenced, agent/AI-oriented CLI usage documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
